coach_rationale: 今天继续磨两样老弱项：过去式 -ed 结尾听辨和动词短语连读。EnglishPod365 笔记仍是第 5–7 周小结，主弱项还是 fill me in、pick up a、kicked me out 这类连读短语和 we've、It'll 的缩写时态，所以这篇生日派对里埋了 turned up、put up、blew out、picked up、cleaned up 五组连读靶子，过去式动词也保持高密度。话题换到家庭生日派对，和之前的登山、茶乡、在线英语课都不重复。
passage: Last Saturday evening, my wife and I held a small birthday party for our daughter at home. Although we had planned only a quiet family dinner, many friends turned up with gifts and balloons, so the house soon felt full of noise and laughter. In the afternoon, I put up colorful balloons in the living room and hung a big banner above the door. My wife baked a chocolate cake and set out fruit, juice, and snacks on the table. At six, our daughter walked in with her eyes closed, and everyone shouted happy birthday when she opened them. She blew out seven candles in one breath, and we all cheered loudly. After dinner, the children played games in the yard while the adults talked about school and work. My daughter opened her gifts one by one and thanked each friend with a big smile. At nine, the guests picked up their coats and left, and we cleaned up the living room together. Although I felt tired, I felt happy because the party had turned a normal Saturday into a memory our daughter will keep for a long time.
